title: Grafana Provisioning and Alerting
summary: Grafana reads datasources and dashboards from provisioned files, queries Prometheus and Loki, and routes alerts through contact points.

nodes.label: Git Repo
nodes.detail: Datasource and dashboard definitions are kept as YAML and JSON in version control and reviewed like code.

nodes.label: Provisioning
nodes.detail: Grafana loads datasource and dashboard providers from its provisioning directory and keeps dashboards in sync with the files.

nodes.label: Prometheus DS
nodes.detail: A datasource of type Prometheus. Panels send PromQL queries to it.

nodes.label: Loki DS
nodes.detail: A datasource of type Loki. Panels and Explore send LogQL queries to it.

nodes.label: Dashboards
nodes.detail: Dashboards combine panels from different datasources. Variables allow one dashboard to serve many services.

nodes.label: Alert Rules
nodes.detail: Rules run queries on a schedule and move between normal, pending and firing states.

nodes.label: Contact Points
nodes.detail: Notification policies route firing alerts to contact points based on labels.

nodes.label: Users and Teams
nodes.detail: Users sign in through local accounts or SSO. Roles and folder permissions control who can view or edit.

steps.title: Config lives in Git
steps.text: Datasources and dashboards are stored as code, so changes are reviewed and reproducible.

steps.title: Provisioning loads them
steps.text: At startup and on interval Grafana reads the files and creates datasources and dashboards.

steps.title: Panels query datasources
steps.text: Each panel sends PromQL to Prometheus or LogQL to Loki and renders the result.

steps.title: Alert rules evaluate
steps.text: Alert rules run queries and fire when thresholds hold for the configured duration.

steps.title: Notifications are routed
steps.text: Firing alerts follow notification policies to contact points; users see state in dashboards.
